messages.content:
Inspect this flowchart image against the requested process. Identify up to 4 specific mistakes: missing stages, wrong arrow direction or branch, overlapping boxes, unreadable text. Name the visible labels involved. Do not invent an error if the image is unclear. Return a short list of concrete corrections.

Requested process:
Create a readable directed flowchart for the following process. Use exactly the quoted stage labels. The first stage is a start node, the last is an end node, any explicitly named decision is a decision node, and all other stages are process nodes. Label decision branches exactly Yes and No. Do not add stages or connections. Begin with "Software release begins", then "Prepare build", then "Run test suite", then the decision "All tests pass?". On No, perform "Fix implementation" and return directly to "Run test suite" before evaluating the decision again. On Yes, perform "Publish release", then finish at "Software release complete".
